No option can be put forward yet: the model could not test your under‑4% monthly churn limit, so it did not assess whether any price choice meets the full goal.

- The comparison itself held up under the changes tested, but it ranks by higher modelled MRR—an assumption rather than a stated goal direction—and the £20k threshold was not converted into the analysis frame.
- Feature-release value is a key uncertainty and is an Olumi-supplied estimate; changing it can alter the ordering in the tested scenarios.
- The current analysis is therefore a provisional comparison, not an answer to whether £59 preserves churn below 4%.
